text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much.
Thanks to you, my body feels a bit...

Thanks to dedicated care throughout the summer,
Manhattan Cafe's physical issues had
somewhat subsided.
And then—inside the bus on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer. How did things
progress with Cafe this summer?
choice_data_list: ...I understood a few of them, but...

text_block_list.text:
I confide what I learned during the camp.
About the behavior of the 'friend.'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. She acts incomprehensibly at times,
but there are also many occasions where it benefits us, huh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"In that case—no, wait.
External pressure, or perhaps self-destructive impulses.
Considering it from various angles..."

And with that, Agnes Tachyon
sank deep into a sea of thought.
"Regardless, autumn awaits. The autumn of blooming that we patiently endured the spring waiting for."
